task: V2 wolf-detection->chase verify test (slate item V2)

lane_compliance.different_file_from_lane_C: Lane C = V6 body-part test (separate new file); this lane = V2WolfChaseTest.cs

what_it_asserts: ONE binary PASS for V2 slate: spawn a WolfEnemy with a live PawnEntity 3.0 units away (inside WolfEnemy.detectionRadius=5.0); advance the real sim ~2.0s; assert [1] pawn in detection range + both alive, [2] wolf DETECTS (gap to pawn decreases after the wolf's 0.4s target-search tick), [3] wolf CHASES (distance to pawn decreases over the window OR closes to within attackRange 0.9). Read-only: only public Hp/IsDead + world transform.position, identical to V7's bandit closing-in distance proof.
bootstrap_convention: Reused V4/V7 RunOne/Assert/GetWhiteSprite + shared report-path convention (outputPath=G:/ai/_v2_wolf_chase_report.json, matching _v4_/_v7_).
wiki_acceptance: Dimension 5 'V1-V9 verification slate', V2 = wolf detection -> chase: 'a gated test asserts a wolf within detection range detects a pawn and chases it (closes distance / enters chase state) as ONE PASS line.'
flags_for_qa: G1 (KEY) — WolfEnemy exposes NO public chase-state / detection accessor. The chase target is the PRIVATE field cachedTarget (WolfEnemy.cs:31); there is no public IsChasing/CurrentTarget/AIState. The test therefore proves chase the only read-only way available: DISTANCE CLOSING over the window (identical to how V7RaidThreatTest proves a bandit closes in). If a binary chase-STATE accessor is wanted, WolfEnemy should add a read-only property, e.g. 'public bool IsChasing => cachedTarget != null && !cachedTarget.IsDead;' or 'public PawnEntity CurrentTarget => cachedTarget;'. FLAGGED, NOT edited (lane rule: no runtime .cs edits).

G2 — WolfEnemy.detectionRadius(5.0)/chaseSpeed(5.0)/attackRange(0.9) are SerializeField private; test does not read them (uses fixed 3.0-unit placement + known constants in asserts). No reflection needed.
G3 — WolfEnemy.FindNearestPawn skips IsDead pawns; PawnEntity.Awake sets Hp=stats.maxHp (alive after one frame), so spawned pawn is a valid target (same bootstrap V7 uses for its colony pawn).
G5 — wolf may reach attackRange(0.9) and stop closing within window; arrival within attackRange is accepted as a closing success (still proves detect+chase).

no_regression_expectation: Adds one isolated companion test (isolated count +1). Does not touch integration/build-click suites. No runtime edit -> no compile impact beyond the new test file (which references only public WolfEnemy/PawnEntity APIs).
